[NDBG.12.3.2] `schema` is required, and may name a built-in schema (a
fault fact, `CallError`) other than the clock tick. `on` is a non-empty list
of `"assert"` and `"retract"`. `"retract"` covers every way a fact leaves
working memory, and the stop names which, as a retractor kind of
[NDBG.14.4.2]. `where` is an optional DS expression in which the fact is
named by its schema name lowercased (`sensor` for `Sensor`).
